verdict.rationale: GitHub's Copilot docs explicitly say you can connect MCP servers to Copilot Chat to bring in context and tools from other applications. The setup docs show the GitHub MCP server being consumed from Copilot Chat in the IDE, configured either remotely or locally, which confirms Copilot acts as an MCP client. Missing for 10: evidence of MCP support in the cloud agent and Copilot CLI, detail on configuring third-party servers and tool permissions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
